description: Says how the values of some detections are masked when a content policy redacts them, and in the snippets shown in the logs. A detection with no masking policy is fully masked with '#'.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

character.description: The character that replaces each masked byte. One printable ASCII character.
character.title: character

detections.description: The names of the detections this masking policy applies to, as content policies name them (for instance ssn, or the name of a custom data type). A detection is in at most one masking policy of a namespace.
detections.title: detections

first.description: The number of characters at the beginning of the value that the mode hides or keeps.
first.title: first

importHash.description: The hash of the structure used to compare with new import version.
importHash.title: importHash

importLabel.description: The user-defined import label that allows the system to group resources from the same import operation.
importLabel.title: importLabel

keepCharacters.description: The characters the masking policy never masks, so a value keeps its shape: the dashes of an SSN, the @ and dots of an email. Every other character is masked, symbols included. Empty masks every character.
keepCharacters.title: keepCharacters

last.description: The number of characters at the end of the value that the mode hides or keeps.
last.title: last

mode.description: Hide masks the first and last characters. Keep masks every character except those. Neither masks the characters listed in Keep Characters.
mode.title: mode

name.description: The internal reference name of the object. It is a sanitized version of Friendly Name if empty.
name.title: name

propagate.description: Propagates the object to all child namespaces. This is always true.
propagate.title: propagate

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: MaskingPolicy
